lead: Michael Jackson was an American songwriter, born on 29 August 1958 in Gary.
He died on 25 June 2009 in Los Angeles at the age of 50.
He is associated with work such as Thriller and Bad and has been recognised with Grammy Lifetime Achievement Award and Grammy Legend Award.
Below you will find a verified overview of Michael Jackson: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Michael Jackson — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Michael Jackson was born on 29 August 1958 in Gary, and holds American nationality. He was given the name Michael Joseph Jackson at birth and is publicly known as Michael Jackson.

Public records name his father, Joe Jackson (talent manager) and his mother, Katherine Jackson. He is a sibling of Rebbie Jackson, Janet Jackson, La Toya Jackson, Jermaine Jackson, Marlon Jackson and Randy Jackson.
His listed education includes Montclair College Preparatory School.
He is recorded as speaking American English and English.

sections.heading: Michael Jackson — Career and Professional Work
paras: Michael Jackson works primarily as a songwriter, musician, dancer, philanthropist, singer and composer.
Among the credits most often linked to Michael are Thriller and Bad.
He performs on voice, piano and drum kit.

sections.heading: Michael Jackson — Filmography and Screen Credits
paras: Public databases list 60 screen credits for Michael Jackson, spanning 2008 to 2026. That breaks down as 32 as performer, 10 as producer and 9 as cast member.

sections.heading: Michael Jackson — Net Worth: What Is Actually Verifiable
paras: Net-worth figures for Michael Jackson circulate widely online, but almost none of them come from an audited or officially published source. BioStar does not invent or repeat unsourced numbers, so no dollar figure is stated on this page.

What can be said from the public record is where his income is likely to originate: professional work as a songwriter, musician, dancer, philanthropist, singer and composer, brand partnerships, sponsored social content and project fees and royalties from credited work.
If a verified figure is published by a credible outlet — a company filing, an election affidavit, or an official disclosure — this section will be updated with the source attached.
